description: Output of the spec role: a requirements and design spec for this codebase, plus only the questions that block implementation.

markdown.description: The whole spec as markdown, starting at a level-2 heading: Problem, Proposed outcome, Affected users and systems, Constraints, Acceptance criteria, Flagged concerns. Do not include an 'Open questions' section; the factory appends one.

open_questions.description: Only questions that block implementation, one self-contained sentence each. Empty array when nothing blocks - that is the normal outcome.

items.description: One blocking question, answerable without this transcript, saying what it blocks.
